what: ”Drag the screen” hint panel — after 1s the four corner arrows vanish in .3s and a hand icon demonstrates dragging by itself: up (−50%·−40%), down (−50%·10%), right (50%·10%), up (50%·−40%), then back in place, .6s power2.inOut each, and then the arrows return. Each press on the panel cross-fades to the next card in .35s, and pressing after the last card clears the panel in .35s power2.out and sends fx:hint-done. For the first hint on drag-to-explore pages, maps and canvases

options.delay: Wait before interaction demo starts (s), default 1
options.step: Duration of one interaction step (sec), default .6
options.fade: Duration for arrows to disappear and return (s), default .3
options.close: Length of the panel clearing at the end (s), default .35 — 0 means instant

parts.arrow: (if any) arrows hidden while the hand moves
parts.card: (If present) Guide cards to page through on each press — the current card gets is-active

use:
Drag the screen

Click the title to open

from.where: index.js (_dragHand·_hideOnInteract) — guide panel that appears .4s after the loader clears, hand step .6s power2.inOut, arrow .3s power1.out, two cards cross-fading .35s, cleared on the second press with .35s power2.out

note: The original stores the press count in sessionStorage and skips the guide board on reopen. The part starts from the beginning every time — whether to show it only once is up to the user (save after fx:hint-done)
